name: Voxhud
author: aashbury
description: A minimalist, theme-aware HUD for Voxtype dictation: listening, processing, done - with the real keys to stop, a click to cancel, and your dictionary one click away in the bar.

barWidget.description: Dictation status. Click for your dictionary; middle-click cancels a recording; right-click previews the HUD.

schema.label: Show the HUD
schema.description: Draw the on-screen HUD while dictating. The bar icon keeps tracking state either way.

schema.label: Level meter
schema.description: A single waveform line, or a row of level bars.

schema.label: Corner brackets
schema.description: Targeting-reticle corners around the card. Sharp-cornered themes only.

schema.label: Show key hints
schema.description: A muted line naming the real keys that stop and insert, read from your live Hyprland bindings.

schema.label: Show where the text is going
schema.description: While processing, name the focused window the text will be typed into.
